body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.40 (naive base rate 0.50) that: Realty Income's initial 2027 AFFO per share guidance has a midpoint ≥$4.59 (≥~3% above 2026 guidance midpoint). Evidence: Q3 2026 release (Nov-2026): AFFO/share $1.12 (+3.7% YoY); 2026 AFFO guidance raised to $4.45–4.46 (from $4.44–4.45); YTD $3.35; reaffirmed $10.0bn 2026 investment volume; 116th consecutive quarterly dividend increase, annualised $3.258 (72.6% payout); raised $472.5m equity at ~$60.49 via ATM forwards, ~18.5m forward shares (~$1.1bn) unsettled. US 10-yr ~4.9–5.1% (Yahoo ^TNX), up from ~4.1% a year earlier. Reasoning: Sector-cycle lead indicator: net-lease AFFO growth = investment spread × volume. With the 10-year near 5% and the stock (cost of equity) weak, spreads on new acquisitions compress and the company usually guides initial growth conservatively. We lean under even odds for a ≥3% midpoint. Resolution: YES if the first 2027 AFFO per share guidance range Realty Income publishes (whenever issued, normally with Q4 2026 results) has a midpoint ≥$4.59. If no 2027 guidance is published by 15-Mar-2027, void. Source: Realty Income Q4 2026 earnings release / supplemental (8-K, EDGAR; realtyincome.com IR). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive: Realty Income's initial annual AFFO guides have implied ~1–4% growth (from memory, unverified); a ≥3% midpoint is roughly a coin flip.
